Message.MsgText: Connector could not return entry because an unknown class type was encountered: ''object type''

Explanation.p: The SNMP Connector was trying to return an entry but the class type was unknown.

Message.MsgText: Connector listening for SNMP traps only.
The 'snmpOID' parameter must be set to use the SNMP Connector.

Explanation.p: The required parameter snmpOID was not specified in the SNMP Connector.

OperatorResponse.p: Specify the snmpOID parameter in the Connector.

Message.MsgText: Getting the next SNMP entry. Comparing response OID ''OID'' of the entry with configured walkOID parameter ''OID''.
Connector could not get next SNMP entry because a bad PDU was received from the SNMP Server. Error occurred: exception

Explanation.p: The SNMP Connector was trying to retrieve the next entry for the SNMP server but failed because a bad PDU was received.

OperatorResponse.p: Verify that the SNMP Server the Connector is receiving data from is still running.

Message.MsgText: Ignoring unsupported link criteria name: ''link criteria''.
Search criteria for entry search: OID=''OID'' version=''version'' host=''hostname'' port=''port number''.
Connector could not add entry because set request to SNMP Server failed. Error occurred: error message

Explanation.p: The SNMP Connector was trying to add an entry to the SNMP server but failed because the set request failed.

OperatorResponse.p: Verify that the SNMP Server the Connector trying to add the entry to is still running and that the entry being added is valid. Also, review the message from SNMP Server for additional detail on why the error occurred.

Explanation.p: The SNMP Connector was trying to retrieve the next entry for the SNMP server but failed because a bad PDU was received.

OperatorResponse.p: Verify that the SNMP Server the Connector is receiving data from is still running.
